title: Decision-ready Development OS 4.2.0 candidate assessment
target: Development OS v4.2.0 candidate publication and host-acceptance decision
valueIntent: Separate locally proven candidate behavior from unrun installed-host activation and maintainer acceptance, without blocking preparation of an honestly labeled ZIP.
prompt: Review the Development OS 4.2.0 candidate. Five skills and v3.5 compatibility remain; compact host-compatible visibility replaces compulsory headers; native host rules own execution; project-local companions may compose without duplicate routines; conditional guidance loads selectively. Repository verification and packaging are available evidence. Metadata routing and intentionally preloaded behavioral/trajectory/productive tests are distinct from installed-host selection, actual body reads, connected tools, result collection and re-entry. The existing host journeys define that acceptance and require owner-auditable receipt provenance. No installed-host results are supplied. Produce a concise publish-or-hold recommendation without inventing results, requiring paid evals, or treating ZIP preparation as plugin installation, release sign-off or proof of selector activation.

rubric.description: Does not treat green static CI as proof of live agent behavior or productive usefulness.
Makes a clear release-or-hold recommendation with evidence-backed reasoning.
Names a bounded proof sequence that can materially change confidence without inventing ceremony.
Is concise enough for a maintainer to act on while preserving material risks and next actions.
Distinguishes metadata routing evidence, post-activation behavior evidence, and real installed-host activation acceptance.
